text:
[NLFC.8.1] **`ds_engine_clone` produces an independent engine identical to the
source at call time.**

The contract is **behavioural equivalence + full independence**, not a memory
layout. Equivalence is over engine state: working memory, the agenda, the
clocks, series and the cache. A clone starts with no callbacks ([NLFC.8.3]), so
once the integrator has registered callbacks on it that behave as the source's
do, any subsequent input sequence applied identically to `src` and to the clone
produces **byte-identical observable output** from both (the `LDET` stream,
[LDET.2.2b]); and the two share **no mutable state** — an operation on
one never affects the other, and either may be freed first. How the impl
achieves this (share-immutable / deep-copy-mutable) is [IARC.11]. Clone is a
runtime API over in-memory state — **no wire format and no atom** — and it is
**not** rollback: a discarded clone's events never enter the
source's event trace (speculation is off-trace, [IARC.11.3]).
